svg.title: C: Performance editor
svg.desc: Editable En Croissant resource-control design. Static prototype, invented example data, not running application evidence.
svg.text: Use a dedicated Performance view within engine details; return to the board after editing.
EDITABLE DESIGN · INVENTED 20-THREAD / 32-GiB COMPUTER · CPU ENGINE, NOT A STRENGTH SETTING
